title: The CLI and hooks need Python 3.9 or newer; without it the plugin's hooks do nothing
why: Matches the existing validator, needs no dependencies, and runs on macOS, Linux, and Windows with Python
alternatives: Port the CLI to a single Node.js file
Warn once per session when Python is missing

resolution.decision: Warn once per session when Python is missing
resolution.note: Owner delegated this call ("you decide what is best"). A Node.js port would swap one runtime requirement for another. The launcher now warns once at session start and keeps other hooks silent.
